chunks: From him, from Fazalat ibn Ayyub, from al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to say: 'I love to present myself to my Lord with my deeds being even/regular.'

key_terms.أَقْدِمَ: I present myself / I go forward

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn say about his deeds when meeting God?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual ideal of 'istawa' (balance/equality) between one's deeds and one's readiness to meet the Creator, reflecting the Shia emphasis on consistent, unwavering practice rather than sporadic intensity. It underscores the concept of *istiqamah* (steadfastness), where the quality and regularity of worship ensure that the believer's record is harmonious and pleasing before Allah.
